mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, member_id, type, content, link_url, is_read AS `read`, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC LIMIT 30
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = TRUE WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, content, link_url) SELECT b.member_id, 'DEADLINE', CONCAT('찜한 캠페인 "', c.title, '" 마감이 3일 남았어요!'), CONCAT('/campaigns/', c.campaign_id) FROM bookmark b JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = b.campaign_id WHERE c.end_date = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND c.status = '모집중'

INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, content, link_url) SELECT b.member_id, 'GOAL_ACHIEVED', CONCAT('찜한 캠페인 "', c.title, '"이(가) 목표 금액을 달성했어요!'), CONCAT('/campaigns/', c.campaign_id) FROM bookmark b JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = b.campaign_id WHERE b.campaign_id = #{campaignId}
INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, content, link_url) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{linkUrl})

INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, content, link_url) SELECT DISTINCT d.member_id, 'REPORT_PUBLISHED', CONCAT('기부하신 캠페인 "', c.title, '"의 기부금 사용 보고가 등록되었어요!'), CONCAT('/campaigns/', c.campaign_id) FROM donation d JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = d.campaign_id WHERE d.campaign_id = #{campaignId}
